recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant Endpoint narrative for this issue; future changes should be made under later Endpoint payload-advertising or connectionType terminology trackers if they alter implementer behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-34261 was Published/Persuasive for R5. It requested changing Endpoint.connectionType from 1..1 to 1..* so a single Endpoint can support multiple connection types, changing Endpoint.payloadType from 1..* to 0..* so payload types can be defined by connection types, and adding a connectionType comment explaining that payload types, mime types, and status apply across all listed connection types.
initial_application: Commit 445d4741d1559c197decca8343f60d1cad753d36 applied the requested source changes in source/endpoint/structuredefinition-Endpoint.xml, and merge commit 29c32a3f611f298e0601cd090b441155fed47286 brought that work into the main history through PR #1832.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. The Jira name Endpoint.payloadType maps to the current Endpoint.payload.type element. Related final trackers FHIR-12342 and FHIR-25393 independently support the connectionType 1..* and payloadType 0..* directions. FHIR-36074 was closed as a duplicate after PA declined to make connectionType optional without a separate tracker. Later FHIR-36589 and FHIR-39617 changed datatype/binding and payload guidance without reversing these cardinalities.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current build-scope source already contains the seed issue's requested connectionType cardinality, payload type cardinality, and explanatory comment, and later related decisions preserve that model.
